project_type: Android multi-module Gradle project (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Material 3 + Hilt)
build_system: Gradle with version catalogs (libs.versions.toml). Module declarations in settings.gradle.kts. Use ./gradlew on Windows (or gradlew.bat). Worktree root: j:\Android\AndroidStudioProjects\Kiro\DevOS\DevOS-AI
test_framework: JUnit 5 + MockK + Turbine for unit tests. ComposeTestRule for UI tests. Run: ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest
verification_instructions: 1. Run ./gradlew :MODULE:assembleDebug after each module change to verify it compiles. 2. Run ./gradlew assembleDebug for full project build. 3. Run ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest for all unit tests. All commands must exit 0.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Use .\gradlew.bat or ./gradlew. Module paths use colons: :core:core-security, :feature:feature-auth, :designsystem, :app. Never push to remote. All new branches local only.
contribution_requirements: Every screen handles 4 UI states (Loading/Success/Empty/Error). No hardcoded colors/dp/sp - always use MaterialTheme tokens. Dark mode first. Every public composable has modifier param. Touch targets >= 48dp. contentDescription on icon-only elements. Hilt only for DI. ViewModels expose StateFlow<UiState>. Navigation via SharedFlow events - never pass NavController into ViewModel.
key_patterns: Design system tokens in designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/designsystem/theme/. Components in designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/designsystem/components/. Feature module pattern: see feature/feature-ai-chat/build.gradle.kts as canonical template. UiState pattern: sealed interface with Loading/Success/Empty/Error. Navigation extension pattern: NavGraphBuilder.featureNavigation(navController) in feature's navigation/ package. Core-security already has androidx-security-crypto declared.
directory_structure: DevOS-AI/ root: app/ (entry point, DI, NavGraph), core/ (core-common, core-database, core-network, core-security - build.gradle.kts only, no src yet), designsystem/ (theme tokens exist, components/ missing), domain/ (domain-ai has models+interfaces), feature/ (feature-ai-chat has build.gradle.kts+ViewModel; all others have empty src dirs but NO build.gradle.kts), .agents/tasks/ (plan files), .kiro/ (specs, steering, implementation-status.md)
